supportedHosts.note: The shipped host packages report 0.1.5-rc.2 while the CLI reports 0.1.5-rc.1; both are supported.

notes: engines.dsh is the authoritative host range; dsh.engines.dsh mirrors it for marketplace discovery.
peerDependencies declare the host packages this plugin imports and are checked independently.
The plugin re-checks the host on every activation, so upgrading into an unsupported host is refused rather than run.
`commands` is optional: without it the /model-orchestrator command is not registered and every tool, prompt section, and control route still works.
Run `node scripts/check-compat.mjs` for a standalone host-compatibility report.
